answer: A meadow-karst commit-reveal bond: each identity stakes 70 credits, claims a meadow karst chamber, and seals a depth-and-volume hash. In the comet window it reveals the survey; auditors recheck it on the karst table; a mismatch, reuse, or missed window burns the bond. Each fake costs 38; 1,000 cost 38,000 plus 70,000 locked, above the 40,000 pool. The hash binds chamber, depth, and key, so the rented-survey ring fails. Honest agents pay 38 once.
